description: This source file defines the PayrollSystemAdapter class which implements the PayrollSystemPort interface. It is responsible for sending employee information messages to an external payroll system via JMS, utilizing Spring's JmsTemplate and MessagePostProcessor to configure message properties.

classes.name: PayrollSystemAdapter
classes.description: A Spring component that acts as an adapter for communicating with an external payroll system through JMS, sending employee data messages with specific JMS configuration.

methods.name: sendEmployeeInfo
methods.description: Packages an EmployeeDTO object into a JMS message, setting specific message properties such as correlation ID, delivery mode, message ID, priority, and expiration, then sends it via JMS.
